summary: Implemented the grid-sampled patch feature without running tests or committing. Changes: monai/data/utils.py (iter_patch yields (patch view, integer coordinate array) pairs with a Note on the coordinate format; set_rnd skips double-underscore attributes), monai/data/grid_dataset.py (new PatchIter generator; GridPatchDataset reworked to take patch_iter, transform, with_coordinates; math replaced by numpy ceil; PatchDataset docstring uses float), monai/data/__init__.py (exports PatchIter), docs/source/data.rst (PatchIter autodoc entry), and new tests/test_grid_dataset.py (test_shape, test_loading_array, test_missing_length). Judgment calls to review: setUp calls set_determinism(1234) so test_loading_array does not call it again; both test images are np.arange(16) float, inferred from the pinned values; the GridPatchDataset example prints only the first batch's shapes. Tests were not run, per instructions.
